documentation_disagreement.official_docs_status_at_capture: Still displays a PaymentBurn warning saying not to delegate until fixCleanup3_4_0 is enabled.
documentation_disagreement.interpretation: The documentation page reports it was last updated one month earlier. The later node-backed explorer records show the amendment enabled at 14:52 UTC. Treat the remaining warning as documentation lag, not as a contrary live-ledger vote.

technical_scope.security_issue: Before the fix, a delegate granted PaymentBurn granular permission could in certain circumstances also mint new fungible tokens or MPTs. The fix separates burn authority from mint authority.
technical_scope.xrp_supply_effect: No change to XRP's native supply; the affected permissions concern issued fungible tokens and MPTs.
